title: Keep disk state reads, sidecar stats and redis version lookup off the event loop
author: FarhanAliRaza

unresolved.first_comment: P1: Run the audit through uv -- anyone following these instructions will invoke the virtualenv interpreter directly, bypassing the repository's required environment-management workflow. Use `uv run --with blockbuster --with aiosqlite scripts/blockbuster_audit.py`...

P2: Run the audit through uv instead of documenting direct .venv/bin/python execution. Use `uv run --with blockbuster --with aiosqlite ...`...

outstanding_asks.ask: Run scripts/blockbuster_audit.py via `uv run --with blockbuster --with aiosqlite ...` instead of documenting direct `.venv/bin/python` invocation.
Use an isolated database path under args.root instead of unconditionally unlinking ./reflex.db in the caller's working directory.

recent_comments.excerpt: Confidence Score: 5/5. The disk-state, static-serving, and Redis changes preserve their existing contracts while moving the identified blocking operations off the event loop.
Merging this PR will not alter performance (32 untouched, 8 skipped benchmarks).

notes: Moves 3 blocking-call sites off the event loop (disk state manager reads, precompressed-static sidecar stat(), redis-py's per-connection version lookup), found via a new scripts/blockbuster_audit.py the PR also adds. Small, well-scoped diff (8 files) with per-fix regression tests.

The ONLY PR in this batch with a real, unaddressed CI failure: pre-commit's pyright hook fails on the PR's own new scripts/blockbuster_audit.py (2 missing-import errors because the pyright env lacks the optional blockbuster/aiosqlite extras the script needs, plus 3 genuine type bugs -- see failing_job_findings). This is a straightforward author-side fix, not infra flake.

5 unresolved review threads, all bot-raised, none replied to or fixed yet: 2 duplicate P1/P2 asks to run the audit script via `uv run --with ...` instead of the bare interpreter shown in its own docstring (a `uv`-workflow violation per AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md), a P1 that the script's unconditional `Path("reflex.db").unlink()` can destroy an unrelated file in the caller's cwd, a P2 Windows path-normalization bug in the audit's own report classifier, and a cosmetic P3 grammar nit in the news fragment.
